quests.protocolRule: What changes when help can't arrive quickly?
quests.crisisScene: A fire starts in a cabin on a passenger ship far from shore. The nearest help is hours away. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: REPORT THE SHIP'S POSITION, THE FIRE, AND HOW MANY PEOPLE ARE ABOARD, AND REQUEST MARITIME ASSISTANCE
quests.actionGuidance: Position, fire, and headcount are what remote responders need, and the crew must fight the fire in the meantime.

quests.protocolRule: Who has the authority and the full picture?
quests.crisisScene: Passengers ask whether to launch lifeboats. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: FOLLOW THE SHIP'S EMERGENCY PLAN AND ABANDON ONLY IF THE CAPTAIN ORDERS IT
quests.actionGuidance: Abandoning ship early can be more dangerous than staying. The captain decides.

quests.protocolRule: Who can guide treatment when no hospital is near?
quests.crisisScene: A passenger on the same ship shows signs of a stroke. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET REMOTE MEDICAL ADVICE AND ARRANGE MEDICAL EVACUATION IF POSSIBLE
quests.actionGuidance: Remote advice guides care, and evacuation may be needed for definitive treatment.

quests.concept: On-Scene Evacuation Prior to Unit Arrival
quests.protocolRule: Who is at greatest risk from prolonged heat?
quests.crisisScene: In a heat wave, a power cut hits a city block with many elderly residents. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: CHECK ON VULNERABLE RESIDENTS, OPEN COOLING SPACES, AND WATCH FOR HEAT ILLNESS
quests.actionGuidance: Elderly residents can deteriorate quickly without cooling, so proactive checks matter.

quests.protocolRule: Which sign separates this from ordinary discomfort?
quests.crisisScene: A resident is confused and hot, with dry skin. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: TREAT IT AS HEATSTROKE, COOL HIM AND CALL AN AMBULANCE
quests.actionGuidance: Confusion with hot, dry skin is a life-threatening heat emergency.

quests.protocolRule: Which residents can't get down without help?
quests.crisisScene: The lifts are out, and a bedridden woman lives on the sixth floor. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: FLAG HER FOR ASSISTED EVACUATION AND GIVE CREWS THE FLOOR AND UNIT
quests.actionGuidance: People who can't move need targeted help, and crews need exact details.

quests.protocolRule: What makes a jammed evacuation road especially dangerous?
quests.crisisScene: An evacuation road is jammed as a wildfire approaches, and cars are overheating. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: REPORT THE JAM AND OPEN AN ALTERNATE ROUTE OR SAFE ZONE
quests.actionGuidance: A stuck line of cars near fire is a trap, so an alternative route or refuge is essential.

quests.protocolRule: Which is worth more: the car or the road?
quests.crisisScene: A car stalls and blocks the only lane. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET THE PASSENGERS OUT AND MOVE THE VEHICLE OR LEAVE IT OFF THE ROAD
quests.actionGuidance: Getting the lane open matters more than the vehicle.

quests.protocolRule: Where are they safer from radiant heat?
quests.crisisScene: A family is trapped in a car as the fire front reaches a corner of the road. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: GIVE THEIR POSITION TO CREWS AND TELL THEM TO STAY IN THE VEHICLE, WINDOWS UP, LOW AND COVERED
quests.actionGuidance: A closed vehicle with people down low offers some protection from heat while crews are directed to them.

quests.protocolRule: What is the bottleneck?
quests.crisisScene: At a marathon, many runners collapse from heat, and the first-aid tent is full. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: REQUEST MORE MEDICAL UNITS, SET UP COOLING, AND TRIAGE THE PATIENTS
quests.actionGuidance: More capacity, cooling, and triage let the sickest be treated first.

quests.protocolRule: Which case needs action right now?
quests.crisisScene: A runner is unconscious near the finish line and complained of chest pain earlier. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: TREAT IT AS A POSSIBLE CARDIAC ARREST, SEND FOR AN AED, AND START COMPRESSIONS
quests.actionGuidance: An unresponsive runner may need immediate resuscitation regardless of the crowd.

quests.protocolRule: What's causing new casualties?
quests.crisisScene: Organizers ask whether to continue the race. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: PAUSE OR STOP IT UNTIL COOLING AND MEDICAL CAPACITY ARE IN PLACE
quests.actionGuidance: Continuing adds more patients to an overloaded system.

quests.protocolRule: Which risks are to people, and which to environment?
quests.crisisScene: A tanker collides near a river, spilling fuel toward the water. A school bus is stopped nearby. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: REPORT THE SPILL, THE BUS AND CHILDREN, AND THE RIVER RISK
quests.actionGuidance: Children, fuel, and water each need a response, so all three must be reported.

quests.concept: On-Scene Evacuation Prior to Unit Arrival
quests.protocolRule: Where do fumes and fuel flow?
quests.crisisScene: The bus driver asks whether to evacuate the children. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: MOVE THEM UPWIND AND UPHILL AWAY FROM THE SPILL AND KEEP THEM TOGETHER
quests.actionGuidance: Upwind and uphill reduces exposure, and staying together prevents anyone going missing.

quests.protocolRule: Where will the fuel end up?
quests.crisisScene: An environmental team asks about drainage nearby. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: REPORT THE STORM DRAINS AND THE WATER PATH TO THE RIVER
quests.actionGuidance: Drain locations let crews block the fuel before it reaches the river.

quests.protocolRule: Do you wait for the full address to send help?
quests.crisisScene: At 3 a.m., a woman whispers from a bedroom with two children. Smoke is under the door and she can only say she's on 'Maple something'. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: USE THE PHONE LOCATION AND ASK FOR THE BUILDING NAME OR CROSS STREET WHILE FIREFIGHTERS ARE SENT
quests.actionGuidance: Help should start moving while more location details are gathered.

quests.protocolRule: What's behind that door?
quests.crisisScene: She wants to open the door to see how bad it is. Input safety code!
quests.optimalResponse: DON'T OPEN IT, STAY LOW, SEAL THE GAPS, AND GO TO THE WINDOW TO BE SEEN
quests.actionGuidance: Opening could expose them to fire and smoke. Sealing and signaling gives firefighters time.

quests.protocolRule: What lets them go straight to her?
quests.crisisScene: Firefighters arrive and ask where she is in the building. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: GIVE THE FLOOR, UNIT, WINDOW SIDE, AND THAT TWO CHILDREN ARE WITH HER
quests.actionGuidance: Exact position and number of people let crews plan the fastest rescue.

quests.protocolRule: Which detail might hide a hazardous cargo?
quests.crisisScene: A driver reports a crash on a mountain road. A car is off the edge, and a truck driver says something smells sweet from his load. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: REPORT THE LOCATION, THE CAR AND THE ODOR, AND KEEP EVERYONE BACK WHILE ASKING ABOUT ANY PLACARD
quests.actionGuidance: An unexplained odor means the load could be hazardous, so crews need to know and people should keep away.

quests.protocolRule: What can moving her risk?
quests.crisisScene: The car's passenger is conscious but says she can't feel her legs. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: TELL HER TO STAY STILL AND REPORT A POSSIBLE SPINAL INJURY
quests.actionGuidance: Loss of sensation suggests spinal damage. Movement could worsen it.

quests.protocolRule: Who else could be at risk arriving?
quests.crisisScene: Rain starts, and the slope beside the wreck looks like it could slip. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: WARN RESPONDERS ABOUT THE UNSTABLE SLOPE AND KEEP CALLERS BACK
quests.actionGuidance: Responders must know about ground stability before approaching.

quests.protocolRule: What is the minimum useful message?
quests.crisisScene: A mall escalator collapse injures many people. The phone network is overloaded and you have one bar. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: SEND A SHORT MESSAGE WITH THE LOCATION, HAZARD, AND ESTIMATED NUMBER OF INJURED
quests.actionGuidance: A brief message gets through overloaded networks and gives the key facts.

quests.protocolRule: Why point at individuals instead of shouting to a crowd?
quests.crisisScene: A woman near the collapse isn't breathing and others are screaming for help. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: ASSIGN SPECIFIC PEOPLE TO CALL, FETCH AN AED, AND START COMPRESSIONS
quests.actionGuidance: Specific assignments prevent everyone assuming someone else will act.

quests.concept: On-Scene Evacuation Prior to Unit Arrival
quests.protocolRule: What order helps them act fastest?
quests.crisisScene: Paramedics arrive and ask you to describe the scene. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: GIVE A BRIEF REPORT: WHERE, WHO IS WORST, AND WHAT HAZARDS REMAIN
quests.actionGuidance: A structured report lets crews go to the most critical patients and avoid hazards.

quests.protocolRule: What is already usable?
quests.crisisScene: A text arrives: 'lost, cold, one hurt, low battery', with a rough location pin. Input rescue code!
quests.optimalResponse: SEND THE PIN TO RESCUE, KEEP THE THREAD OPEN, AND ASK SHORT QUESTIONS
quests.actionGuidance: The pin can start the search while brief questions fill in details.

quests.protocolRule: What is confusion plus shivering telling you?
quests.crisisScene: They report the injured member is shivering and confused. Input rescue code!
quests.optimalResponse: TELL THEM TO SHELTER, INSULATE HIM, STAY TOGETHER, AND UPDATE RESCUE
quests.actionGuidance: Confusion with shivering suggests worsening cold exposure. Shelter and insulation are priorities.

quests.protocolRule: How do you stay in touch without draining the phone?
quests.crisisScene: Fog prevents a helicopter and the ground team is four hours away. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: GIVE SURVIVAL GUIDANCE AND SET CHECK-IN TIMES TO SAVE BATTERY
quests.actionGuidance: Scheduled contact preserves battery and keeps the group supported.

quests.protocolRule: How many separate needs are there?
quests.crisisScene: A bus has crashed into a fuel station. There's a fire at the pumps, people are screaming on the bus, and a woman on the pavement isn't moving. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FIRE, MEDICAL AND POLICE, REPORT THE FUEL FIRE, THE BUS AND THE INJURED, AND WARN PEOPLE TO STAY BACK
quests.actionGuidance: Fire, fuel, casualties, and bystander safety must all be reported together.

quests.protocolRule: Who is now in danger?
quests.crisisScene: A bystander says two more fuel tanks are underground near the fire. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: REPORT THE TANKS IMMEDIATELY AND WIDEN THE SAFE DISTANCE
quests.actionGuidance: Hidden tanks raise the explosion risk, so crews and bystanders need to be told at once.

quests.protocolRule: Which must be true before the others can be safe?
quests.crisisScene: Command asks you to state the order of priorities. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: SAVE LIVES FIRST, THEN CONTAIN THE FIRE AND FUEL, THEN CONTROL THE CROWD AND TRAFFIC
quests.actionGuidance: Life comes first, and controlling the fire and fuel makes the rest safe to manage.
